_comment: Findings that are known, judged, and not blocking the build.
Every entry needs a reason a person can check and a review_by date.
Past that date the entry stops suppressing and CI goes red, which is the
only mechanism that makes anyone look at it again.

allow.reason: SheetJS stopped publishing to npm at 0.18.5, so there is no version to bump to; the fixes live at cdn.sheetjs.com. It parses the shift master upload in the browser (src/app/admin/draft/parseShiftMaster.ts), behind the admin login. Moving the install to the vendor CDN is a decision about build-time dependencies on a third-party host and is pending.

Held at 0.38.6 by fastapi==0.115.0, which pins starlette<0.39.0. The advisories reach 1.3.1, so closing them means upgrading FastAPI 26 minor versions across a 31,500-line main.py with 1,781 routes. They land on the multipart upload path. Scheduled as its own verified change, not a drive-by bump.
